HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
